labels.analyzeGlobalDesc: Firestore keeps its own index statistics; Studio has none to update.
labels.vacuumGlobalDesc: Studio sends Firestore no maintenance: this version only reads.
labels.statementLanguage: one Firestore Admin SDK read chain starting at db, written inline and never run as JavaScript, for example db.collection("users").where("age", ">=", 18).orderBy("age").limit(100); the chain may end in .get(), .count(), .aggregate({ total: AggregateField.sum("amount") }), .findNearest({ ... }) or .explain(), and db.doc("users/alice").get(), db.listCollections(), db.collection("users").listDocuments() and db.getAll(db.doc("users/alice"), ...) are also accepted; writes are refused
labels.slowQueriesEmptyState: Studio reads no Firestore query statistics
labels.sessionsEmptyState: Firestore does not list client sessions
